appDescription.message: Quick-capture web content and proxy AI requests for ThreatCaddy threat intelligence. Data stays local on your device by default.

saveFailed.message: Failed to save. Please try again.

noCaptures.message: No captures yet. Select text on any page and right-click to save.

allowCaddyAIDesc.message: Grants access to AI provider APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral).

allowUrlFetchingDesc.message: Required for the /fetch command and non-localhost local LLMs.

allowFileAccessDesc.message: Required to send clips to file:// standalone builds.

allowFileAccessHint.message: To enable: go to chrome://extensions, find ThreatCaddy, and toggle "Allow access to file URLs".

howToUseContextMenu.message: Select text and right-click "Save to ThreatCaddy"

howToUseShortcutSuffix.message: (clips selection, or full page if nothing selected)

privacyText.message: Clips stay on this device until delivered or exported. Optional AI, URL fetching and approved app connections can send data to configured services.

targetUrlDesc.message: The ThreatCaddy instance URL this extension connects to.

errorExtensionInvalidated.message: Extension context invalidated. Please reload this page.

errorHttpHttpsOnly.message: Only HTTP and HTTPS URLs are supported

errorUrlPermissionRequired.message: URL access permission required. Open the ThreatCaddy extension popup and enable "Allow URL fetching", then try again.

errorRequestTimedOut15.message: Request timed out (15s). The page may be unreachable.

errorBlockedInternal.message: Blocked: requests to internal/private addresses are not allowed

errorBlockedDomain.message: Blocked: $hostname$ is not in the allowed proxy domains list

errorCaddyAIPermission.message: CaddyAI permission required. Open the ThreatCaddy extension popup and enable "Allow CaddyAI" under Permissions.

errorHostPermissionLocalLLM.message: Host permission required for $hostname$. Open the ThreatCaddy extension popup and enable "Allow URL fetching" under Permissions.

errorTimedOutPageLoad.message: Timed out waiting for page to load

errorDeliverClips.message: Failed to deliver clips — bridge.js could not reach the page. Check that the extension has permission for this site.

captureSaveFailed.message: The capture was not saved. Your draft is retained.

captureChangeFailed.message: The capture change was not saved. Refresh and retry.

approvalTrust.message: Approve only an app you trust. This exact origin (including its port), or exact standalone file, may use the extension's granted capabilities.

revokeAppsQuestion.message: Disconnect all approved apps? Captures and browser permissions will not be deleted. Reapprove an app to reconnect it.

localAINone.message: No local AI endpoint approved for this app.

localAIApproveFirst.message: Approve this app before saving a local AI endpoint.

localAIReadFailed.message: Unable to read local AI approval: $detail$

invalidLocalAI.message: Local AI must use HTTP(S) without credentials in its URL

localAIPermissionDenied.message: Local AI permission was denied; saved approval is unchanged.

invalidAppTarget.message: Use an HTTP(S) app or exact standalone file without credentials

appApproved.message: App approved. Reload the app tab to connect.

notificationEnabledDesc.message: Desktop notifications enabled. Operating system settings may still suppress display. Revoke permission in your browser extension settings.

notificationDisabledDesc.message: Desktop notifications are disabled; in-app alerts remain available.

notificationWaitingDesc.message: Waiting for the browser permission response. If no prompt appears, check your browser extension permissions or reopen this panel.

notificationNotEnabled.message: Desktop notifications were not enabled; in-app alerts remain available. Check your browser extension permissions if no prompt appeared.

clipReviewSubtitle.message: Browse and manage your captured clips

deleteCaptureQuestion.message: Are you sure you want to delete this capture?

configureTargetFirst.message: Please configure a target URL first

invalidTargetUrlDetail.message: Invalid target URL — only http, https, and file:// allowed

targetPermissionDenied.message: Permission denied — extension needs access to this site

fileAccessDisabled.message: File URL access is disabled. Check this extension's file access settings in your browser before retrying.

defaultsApplied.message: Defaults applied to all unsent clips

clearAllQuestion.message: This will permanently delete all $count$ capture(s). This cannot be undone.

capturesCleared.message: Confirmed captures cleared; newer captures were retained

capturesLoadFailed.message: Unable to load captures. Reopen this page or retry Refresh.
